notes.title: DEVLOG #2
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Here’s the second dev log for Infinite Rails, where I’m excited to share the latest features and updates I’ve been working on. I’ve made some big strides in gameplay mechanics, track-building tools, and overall immersion. Let’s dive into the new additions!

[h2][b]1) Wood Logs and Wood Depot:[/b][/h2]
Wood logs have been added as a new transport item! Now you can pick up wood from station and deliver it to a Wood Depot, where it will be stored. This opens up new possibilities for logistics and managing resources, adding a layer of complexity to the game. The Wood Depot is essential for handling wood shipments, and players will need to carefully plan their routes to make sure the wood gets delivered efficiently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354782/c5b1f3d2e1160507cf9fc9340f5d3db6f9a2b6e5.png[/img]


[h2][b]2) New Procedural Passenger Models:[/b][/h2]
The old static passengers have been replaced with procedural models that are generated dynamically. These new models look different every time, which makes transporting passengers from one station to another feel more varied and realistic. This adds a fresh, ever-changing dynamic to your station operations, making each trip feel unique.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354782/9432a62e813a09b068f8b7395f9e5fcfb893c9db.png[/img]


[h2][b]3) Parallel Tool:[/b][/h2]
I’ve added a Parallel Tool, allowing you to easily copy and place track curves right next to each other. This makes building large rail networks faster and more efficient, eliminating the need for manual duplication. Now, designing smooth, continuous track layouts is much easier, saving you time and effort.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354782/65dfa969d885b59c4f83a9d470ad2474800e21fe.png[/img]


[h2][b]4) Recarve Tool:[/b][/h2]
With the Recarve Tool, you can restore the terrain to its original profile. This tool allows you to fix any unwanted changes to the landscape, giving you more control over how your world evolves. If you make a mistake or want to adjust the terrain after laying down tracks, the Recarve Tool has got you covered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354782/ee24fdcea84552c7c2c814396e6a24de248829e1.png[/img]


[h2][b]5) Turntable with Lighting:[/b][/h2]
A Turntable has been added to the game, and it’s fully functional! It’s perfect for rotating trains and storing locomotives in tight spaces. I’ve also included lighting for night-time use, which makes it easier to operate during the darker hours and adds some cool atmosphere to your rail yards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354782/9f43b42f3e653d27c8d7815f1deb7b35d4f75475.png[/img]


[h2][b]6) Fully Integrated Sound Effects:[/b][/h2]
All the sound effects are now fully implemented and integrated. Whether it’s the sound of a passing train, track rumbling, or the noise environment, everything is designed to immerse you in the world of Infinite Rails. The sounds adapt to the environment, adding depth and making the game feel alive.

That’s all for this update! I’m really excited about these new features and I think they’ll make a huge difference in gameplay. There’s a lot more to come, so stay tuned for the next dev log. Thanks for all the support, and happy building! 🚂✨

notes.title: DEVLOG #1
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We’ve been working tirelessly to get the game ready for an Early Access release as soon as possible. Every day brings us closer to delivering a rich, interactive, and engaging experience, and we can’t wait to share it with you all.

Here’s a detailed look at what we’ve accomplished so far: (not available in demo)

[h1][b]Character Editor is Complete:[/b][/h1]

The character editor is now fully functional, allowing players to customize their in-game characters in great detail. From clothing to facial features, you’ll have full control over your character’s appearance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354782/62f20cf191d89b3da5dec6703be644acdcb0fa53.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354782/21b0f8e65764edb39cbe03b820af511da7ba8885.png[/img]


[h1][b]Westinghouse Air Brake System:[/b][/h1]
The Westinghouse air brake system is integrated and fully functional, including the locomotive compressor and pressure gauges. This complex system adds realism and depth to the gameplay, making every decision crucial when managing the train.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354782/b8851de0a374d73912e7668bd7391e057ece59db.png[/img]


[h1][b]Fully Interactive Flight Mode (including switches):[/b][/h1]
We’ve made everything in the flight mode interactive. You can now interact with switches, levers, and other controls, giving you a full experience as you take control of your train.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354782/d1891bad79cdf161d13e1edd15083804dd340f1f.png[/img]


[h1][b]Non-Flat Mainmenu World:[/b][/h1]
We’ve taken a huge step forward with the terrain. The world is no longer flat! It’s now more immersive and natural, with dynamic elevations and a more realistic feel in main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354782/7e87a9f65bc52d5f37d210c487b1cbf7272e361b.png[/img]


[h1][b]Class 08 Diesel Locomotive Modeling:[/b][/h1]
We’re currently working on modeling the iconic Class 08 diesel locomotive. This locomotive, known for its reliability and versatility, will be a key addition to the game. It’s often used for shunting duties, but with its robust design, it can handle a variety of tasks, making it an excellent choice for train operations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354782/60aa4a934d8793460087a7db594835ba7b49562c.png[/img]


[h1][b]Sound Development:[/b][/h1]
We’re also in the process of finalizing sound effects to enhance immersion. From engine sounds to environmental effects, we’re making sure everything sounds authentic and engaging.


We’re really excited about the progress we’ve made, and we can’t wait to welcome new players to the community. Please share this update with your friends and stay tuned for more news. Early Access is just around the corner!

Thanks for your continued support!
